name: pricing-16
description: Team size stepper that recommends a plan with features and a calculated monthly total.

files.content:
"use client" import { useState } from "react" import { Check, Users } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const sizes = [ { label: "Just me", seats: 1 }, { label: "2-5", seats: 5 }, { label: "6-20", seats: 20 }, { label: "21-100", seats: 100 }, { label: "100+", seats: 0 }, ] function recommend(seats: number) { if (seats === 1) return { plan: "Personal", perSeat: 0, reason: "Free forever for a single workspace owner.", features: ["3 projects", "Core blocks", "Community support"], } if (seats <= 5) return { plan: "Team", perSeat: 15, reason: "Shared libraries and reviews for a small crew.", features: ["Unlimited projects", "Shared libraries", "Review links", "Email support"], } if (seats <= 20) return { plan: "Studio", perSeat: 13, reason: "Volume discount kicks in and you get permissions.", features: ["Everything in Team", "Roles and permissions", "Branded exports", "Priority support"], } if (seats <= 100) return { plan: "Business", perSeat: 11, reason: "SSO and audit logs for growing organisations.", features: ["Everything in Studio", "SAML SSO", "Audit log", "Quarterly business reviews"], } return { plan: "Enterprise", perSeat: -1, reason: "Custom terms, security review and a dedicated team.", features: ["Everything in Business", "SCIM provisioning", "99.99% SLA", "Dedicated CSM"], } } export default function Pricing16() { const [step, setStep] = useState(2) const seats = sizes[step]!.seats const rec = recommend(seats) const total = rec.perSeat > 0 ? rec.perSeat * seats : rec.perSeat return (

How big is your team?

We'll recommend the plan most companies your size choose.

{sizes.map((size, index) => ( ))}

Recommended

{rec.plan}

{rec.reason}

    {rec.features.map((feature) => (
  • {feature}
    • ))}

{total === -1 ? "Custom" : `$${total}`}

{total === -1 ? "Annual contract, volume pricing" : total === 0 ? "Free forever" : `per month for ${seats} seats ($${rec.perSeat} each)`}

) }
